question: J♠b while 2♦h was new: why hold back 2♦?
text: I was focused on setting up the K♣c, and 2♦h wasn't urgent and had no immediate consequences, so putting it off for one move has no detrimental effect.

question: 4♥f while 3♠h was new: why the waste play first?
text: The same reason as your last question: it wasn't urgent and I wanted to offset the waste pile before I forgot. When multiple plays are available, as long as not making one of the plays has no immediate detrimental effects if it remains unplayed, it's okay to leave it unplayed as long as not playing it is a "neutral" decision. I can't make two plays simultaneously, and I often focus on the more "complex" moves first.
